title: Shared Factory file definitions (v1alpha1)
description: Definitions shared by factory.yaml, agent frontmatter, automation frontmatter, and runner YAML.

nonEmptyString.description: A string that is non-empty after trimming surrounding whitespace.

nullableNonEmptyString.description: A non-empty string override, or null to inherit.

clearableString.description: A string override. Null or empty explicitly clears an inherited value; omitting the field inherits it.

alias.description: Factory display handle, used as the @-mention name on integrated platforms. Letters, digits, spaces, '-', '_', and '.' only, at most 60 characters. Case is preserved; uniqueness is compared case-insensitively across the workspace.

credentialStrategy.description: Whose credentials a run executes with. Omit to leave the value already stored on the server untouched.

agentType.description: MAIN is an authoring alias for FOREMAN. Exactly one Agent in the tree must declare MAIN or FOREMAN. Omitting agentType resolves to CUSTOM.

secretName.description: Name of a managed secret already registered for the team.

secrets.description: Managed secret names. Declaring the field at Agent or Automation level replaces the inherited list rather than adding to it.

uniqueSecrets.description: Managed secret names. Duplicates are rejected in factory.yaml.

warpId.description: Warp-managed MCP server ID. This is the only key an entry may carry.

mcpServers.description: Managed MCP servers keyed by the name the agent sees. Declaring the field at Agent or Automation level replaces the inherited map.

harnessAuth.description: Credentials for a non-Oz harness. Null explicitly clears inherited auth.

type.description: Harness config name. claude-code is an accepted alias for claude.

reasoningLevel.description: Not supported by the oz harness.

harnessOverride.description: Sparse harness override. Must declare at least one of type, model, reasoningLevel, or auth.

harnessDefault.description: Factory-level harness default. Both type and model are required.

modelXorHarnessRequired.description: Declare exactly one of model (Oz harness shorthand) or harness (explicit harness block).

modelXorHarnessOptional.description: model and harness are mutually exclusive.

ozModelDefault.description: Oz model ID. Shorthand for harness: {type: oz, model: <id>}. Mutually exclusive with harness.

ozModelOverride.description: Oz model ID, or null to inherit. Shorthand for harness: {type: oz, model: <id>}. Mutually exclusive with harness.

runnerRef.description: Name of a runner declared under runners/<name>.yaml, or null to inherit.

environmentId.description: Cloud environment ID the run executes in, or null to inherit.

workerHost.description: Self-hosted worker host. Null or empty clears an inherited host and defers to the workspace default.
